items.text: Plans and billing: Starter is US$2 a month and Pro is US$10 a month, billed by Stripe. Your plan renews every month until you cancel. You can cancel at any time from your dashboard, and your plan keeps working until the end of the month you paid for. Partial months are not refunded.

Limits: each plan has a monthly recording allowance, a maximum number of people per session, and a keep period for files, as shown on the pricing page. Recording stops when the monthly allowance is used up.

Your recordings: you own what you record. We store and process recordings only to provide the service. Files are deleted automatically at the end of your plan’s keep period, so download anything you want to keep before then.
Consent: you must tell everyone you record that they are being recorded and have their agreement, and you must follow the recording laws that apply where you and they are.
Browser: Yapcorder works in Google Chrome. Other browsers are not supported.
Early access: Yapcorder is new. We work to make every recording arrive complete, but we cannot guarantee it. For recordings that matter, keep a backup recording while the service is in early access.
Fair use: do not use Yapcorder to record people without their knowledge, or for anything unlawful. We may suspend accounts that do.
